notes.title: 1.0.4.1 Cutscene Test #2
notes.content:
Reorganized the game's directory in order to (possibly) get the game to play the cutscene movies.
Testing showed that when you open the actual exe file within the game files, the cutscenes work properly. However, it didn't work when you launched it through Steam itself. This directory change should keep all of the files together in order for the game to find the movie files and play them properly.

I can't test this without posting it as a live build, so I'll comment under this if it worked or not.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Cutscene Fix(?)
notes.content:
Working on tests to fix the cutscenes that are supposed to play at the end of the game. 
Its embarrassing to only find out about this now, since it works fine in the itch release. There's no excuse and I apologize.
My current theory is that steam api interferes with the video player. Will post a second update if it works.

Fixes:
- Fixed some of the quest dialogue to not bleed into the UI during day 2
- Fixed some punctuation errors in quests during day 2

(Please send any other typos/bugs to the socials included via DM)

Fixes:
- Fixed a couple of typos throughout the game.

notes.title: 1.0.3 The Game is Clearer Now
notes.content:
Changes:
- The teachers in the lower room of the school now have additional dialogue instructing the player on how to get to class and how to advance the story.

- Arrow signs have been added in the hallway to give better instruction on where to go in the upper room of the school. If you're still stuck by that point, press enter on the ends of the hallways.

- Mouse Cursor no longer appears on screen.

notes.title: ver 1.0.2
notes.content:
